title: Sucker-bet profile, applied: the engine now quotes only parlays whose win chance is 40% or less (your 12:42 app change) and no pregame leg over 70% (I tightened that from 80% just now, live without a restart). The graded market data says what a sucker bet is by shape, not by buyer: of 6,471 graded parlays, the ones we still allow earn makers about +3.3% of the pot at the clearing price; a leg of 80%+ loses -9% to -13%, three favourite legs -10%, and two-leg parlays with a moderate favourite pair +11.6%. I looked for a way to tell sharp buyers from casual ones (how fast they accept, how big a stake): nothing, and no row has a buyer id. So the filters are the only detector, and the rest is volume of independent fills. The identical-parlay guard goes live with one engine reset at ~18:31 UTC.
